pv32:1.1: Naranāripurakkhato yuvā rajanīyehi kāmaguṇehi sobhasi divasaṃ anubhosi kāraṇaṃ kim akāsi purimāya jātiyā ti. || ||
pv32:2.1: Ahaṃ Rājagahe ramme ramaṇīye Giribbaje migaluddo pure āsiṃ lohitapāṇi dāruṇo. || ||
pv32:3.1: Avirodhakaresu pāṇisu puthusattesu paduṭṭhamānaso vicariṃ atidāruṇo sadā parahiṃsāya rato asaññato. || ||
pv32:4.1: Tassa me sahāyo suhadayo saddho āsi upāsako so ca maṃ anukampanto nivāresi punappunaṃ: || ||
pv32:5.1: Mākāsi pāpakaṃ kammaṃ mā tāta duggatiṃ agā sace icchasi pecca sukhaṃ virama pāṇavadhā asaṃyamā. || ||
pv32:6.1: Tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā sukhakāmassa hitānukampino nākāsiṃ sakalānusāsaniṃ cirapāpābhirato abuddhimā. || ||
pv32:7.1: So maṃ puna bhūrisumedhaso anukampāya saṃyame nivesayi: sace divā hanasi pāṇino atha te rattiṃ bhavatu saññamo. || ||
pv32:8.1: Svāhaṃ divā hanitva pānino virato rattim ahosi saññato rattāhaṃ paricāremi divā khajjāmi duggato. || ||
pv32:9.1: Tassa kammassa kusalassa anubhomi rattiṃ amānusiṃ divā paṭihatā va kukkurā upadhāvanti samantā khādituṃ. || ||
pv32:10.1: Ye ca te satatānuyogino dhuvaṃ payuttā sugatassa sāsane maññāmi te amatam eva kevalaṃ adhigacchanti padaṃ asaṅkhatan ti. || ||
